title: Milestone
use: one number that is the whole post — a TVL crossing, a claims total, a positions count

eyebrow.label: the small mono line above the number, e.g. MILESTONE or TOTAL VALUE LOCKED

value.label: the number itself, already formatted — $228.4K, ~$21.7M, 66,952. Ten, not twelve: no figure the live feed publishes reaches twelve, and sizing for one cost 40px on every real card

label.label: what the number is, in plain words

asOf.label: the moment the number was true — 24: the footer line grew to 34px for mobile, and 24 is exactly a real stamp ("31 Aug 2026 08:24:08 UTC")
